decisions.statement: An image the registry already holds under its tag is built again by nothing.
A build is refused where an input differs from the commit HEAD is at.
The Dockerfile is written outside the checkout, because a build made it.
The builder runs in the cluster and the workstation only asks it.
A build handed a folder takes its context and its Dockerfile from that folder.
A build handed a folder keeps no cache, that folder being made new each run.
Each thing a publish wrote outside the checkout is named as soon as it is written.
An image already in the registry is named where a later image throws.

definition: a built image put in the cluster's registry by the cluster's builder
